💧 A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek.)
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek telling A person, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair about you. It's picking up decorations as it travels.

A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek drew big brown-capped mushrooms with thick pale stems and sponge pores, no gills in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
👀 Someone mentioned Denver and the person in their 40s, with a scarred cheek answered to it a beat late — like responding to a name that isn't quite yours.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek).
A person, maybe 40s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."

◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Benoit — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)

🛡️ Tamika, Neha, Wei, Grace and Brian met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Tamika, Neha, Wei, Brian are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Gina, Tamika, Andre, Wei and Grace met them at the door — 5 put down. Gina, Andre, Wei, Grace are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Andre just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Helga just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gina, Tamika, Andre, Wei and Grace met them at the door — 4 put down. Grace didn't come back. Gina, Tamika, Andre, Wei are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Helga just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Benoit Lambert, 45 — a Baker. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, War Cry, Echo Location, Extra Stomach, Feast Engine.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Pedro just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sam, Atik and Pedro met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Sam, Atik, Pedro are hurt.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
🛡️ Nina met them at the door — 1 put down. Nina is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
